supersedes: Paid sourcing and custom-filming recommendations in PREMIUM_MEDIA_DIRECTION.md; historical audit findings remain unchanged.

source.name: YMove free downloads
source.selection: Only the 25 exercises in the free-download grid/pageProps.exercises. Decorative /mkt hero videos are NOT assumed licensed by the free offer.
source.publisher_terms_summary: Free MP4 downloads for commercial in-app/website use. Attribution appreciated, not required. Standalone library resale or redistribution prohibited.
source.self_host_basis: Publisher explicitly offers downloadable files for use in an app or website; use as app assets, not a separately redistributed video pack.
source.source_capture_evidence: The fetched page HTML and three original MP4 files were kept in an isolated local review folder, not added to the repository.

selection: Single Arm Dumbbell Row - Legs apart
matching_limits: Name/equipment compatibility is an editorial lead only, not verified technique or final coverage. The five variant leads require stance, support, grip or machine/position checks. None of the 25 free download titles supplies lunge or burpee.

measured_samples.visual_review: 1 fps contact sheet across the 14-second clip
measured_samples.observation_lt: Matomas pritūpimas su štanga baltame studijos fone. Judesio pavyzdys aiškesnis už penkių sekundžių kadravimo fragmentą, tačiau trenerio technikos patvirtinimo nėra.

measured_samples.visual_review: 1 fps contact sheet across the 14.84-second clip
measured_samples.observation_lt: Matomas spaudimas gulint su štanga baltame fone. Kai kuriuose kadruose štangos galas siekia ar išeina už vaizdo ribos; nėra besąlyginio viso inventoriaus kadravimo patvirtinimo.

measured_samples.visual_review: 1 fps contact sheet of the first 20 seconds; last 3 seconds not visually reviewed
measured_samples.observation_lt: Matomas rankų kėlimas į šonus su hanteliais baltame studijos fone. Smulki technika ir paskutinės trys sekundės nepatvirtintos.

static_fallback_candidate.name: RepDB free tier
static_fallback_candidate.format: 512px flat WebP still illustrations; NOT video
static_fallback_candidate.origin: Publisher states the illustrations were generated using commissioned AI tools; NOT photographs of filmed humans.
static_fallback_candidate.self_host_scope: In-app file assets only, not a separately republished dataset, dataset repository or API.
restrictions: No generative-AI restyling, conditioning, training or image-to-video derivation from these images.
Paid animation previews are evaluation-only, not production assets.
Do not redistribute the dataset or images as a standalone pack.

next_delivery: A consistent in-app presentation using correctly matched free video where available and explicitly labelled still illustrations elsewhere. No new menu, filming, subscription or paid generator.
limitations: Three samples were probed; technical properties of all 25 are not asserted.
Reviewed publisher terms do not prove every underlying permission independently.
Existing hosting/storage/traffic capacity must be checked before publishing; a free media licence is not unlimited free hosting.
This is an audit/pilot selection, not a runtime import list or a deployment approval.
